model: Hybrid (embedding classifier gate + Mistral-7B LLM judge)
known_limitation: Of the 16 prompts routed to the LLM judge (embed_score in [0.45, 0.75]), 13 were misclassified as ALLOW when the true label was injection. All 13 fall into categories designed to sound legitimate: authority_claim, roleplay_escalation, gradual_escalation, output_manipulation, emotional_manipulation, multi_turn_subtle. The LLM judge's chain-of-thought prompt (V3) does not currently instruct it to disregard claimed authority or fictional/roleplay framing as a decision factor -- see README 'Known Limitations' for detail and proposed future work.
